steps.what: Locate authorised records and verify their provenance, scope and completeness
Examine original records for possible links and contradictory evidence
Enter the actual entities, relationships, uncertainty and source references for the evidence chart
Lay out and check the actual evidence-link chart against its original sources
Write and check the internal findings with limitations and unresolved evidential links

tasks.design: Use the native {OTHER} link-chart layout on relationships the detective reads, enters and source-checks explicitly. OTHER means investigative link-chart software; the design reduces repeated chart placement while retaining evidence reading, entity decisions and actual findings writing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual placement and redrawing can duplicate work after relationships have been entered.
tasks.enabler_now: A native chart layout can arrange entered entities without deciding that a suspected link is true.
tasks.still_hard: Namesakes, uncertain dates and contradictory evidence require original-record examination.
tasks.human_edge: The detective distinguishes an investigative lead from an established evidential relationship.
tasks.altitude: Reduce chart mechanics within source-led investigation.

evidence.claim: i2 Analyst's Notebook provides link charts and network analysis; this supports chart capability, not a measured saving.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured hypotheses for an existing chart-and-findings branch.
Entity and relationship capture is counted in s3, not supplied free.
Native layout must be enabled only within authorised investigative systems; no autonomous suspect ranking or evidential inference is introduced.
Internal chart and findings saves are ordinary author work without an approval gate.
research_questions: Does automatic placement reduce chart mechanics after source checking and relationship entry?

already_counted.description: Read and enter relationships in s2 and s3; inspect and manually repair chart layout in s4.

incremental.description: Amortised layout and source-reference regression checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Native placement removes 25*0.20=5 chart hours less 1 upkeep, net 4. Cautious case: unresolved namesakes and conflicting chronology force manual chart reconstruction, leaving only 1.5 hours of repeated placement removed and 0.5 net; all evidential decisions stay manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and serve search and arrest warrants

steps.what: Verify the warrant grounds, identity, address, scope and supporting evidence
Write the actual search or arrest warrant application and supporting statement
outputs: draft warrant application and supporting statement

steps.what: Check the final application, exhibits and court recipient and approve submission
inputs: draft warrant application and supporting statement
outputs: approved final warrant application and court destination

steps.what: Submit the approved warrant application and exhibits to the designated court
inputs: approved final warrant application and court destination

steps.what: Review the grounds and approve the final warrant's exact target, scope and service limits
outputs: issued final warrant with approved target, scope and service limits

steps.what: Check the issued warrant, plan lawful execution and brief the serving officers
inputs: issued final warrant with approved target, scope and service limits
outputs: checked service plan within the issued warrant

steps.what: Serve the issued search or arrest warrant within its approved legal limits
inputs: issued final warrant with approved target, scope and service limits
checked service plan within the issued warrant
outputs: served warrant and actual service outcome

steps.what: Enter the actual warrant service outcome in the required case record
inputs: served warrant and actual service outcome

tasks.design: Reuse the authorised {DOCS} warrant application's fixed headings and stable court-format fields while the detective writes and checks its substantive grounds. Keep final application submission separate from judicial approval of the actual warrant, physical service and the existing service record; no legal decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring application furniture can be retyped around case-specific evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: A native authorised form can supply fixed headings without supplying legal grounds.
tasks.still_hard: Necessity, accurate identity, lawful scope and safe service require accountable people.
tasks.human_edge: Investigators and the issuing authority remain responsible for coercive powers.
tasks.altitude: A very small form improvement within a human warrant process.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: authorised document forms can retain fixed warrant-application headings; the judicial route depends on jurisdiction.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a judicially issued warrant branch and require local validation.
B=90 detective hours out of 100 whole-workflow hours; judicial approval is other-role time and is not saved.
The small actual service entry already exists and is fully retained; any separate return filed to court needs its own local workflow and gate, not a hidden automated send.
A changed target or scope requires a new warrant authorisation; the form never creates authority.
unknowns: Local court form and service procedure
research_questions: Is any fixed application furniture still entered manually in the authorised local process?

already_counted.description: Detective checks and repairs the application and its exhibits in s2 and s3.
The issuing authority reviews and authorises the warrant in s5; this labour is not a detective saving.

incremental.description: Amortised checking of the authorised form version.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final application, exhibits and court destination; any edit voids submission approval
s5 issued final warrant's exact target, scope, validity and service limits; changed scope requires renewed judicial approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=90. Fixed form fields remove 25*0.04=1 whole-graph hour, or 1.111 per 100 detective hours, less 0.5 upkeep gives 0.61 net. Cautious case: a complex warrant uses bespoke exhibits and only 0.5 whole-graph hours of fixed furniture is reusable, giving 0.055 net after upkeep, rounded down to 0.05. Judicial review, service and service entry remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain the crime-scene officer's incident summary

steps.what: Obtain the incident summary from the officer without disturbing crime-scene evidence
Write the actual contemporaneous notebook summary with source attribution and uncertainties

tasks.design: Keep the scene briefing and contemporaneous {DOCS} notebook entry separate and manual. The existing notebook structure already supplies attribution fields; no transcript, extraction service or extra incident report is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The summary is situated information from a person at an active evidence scene.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional change is established beyond the existing notebook fields.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding uncertainty without contaminating evidence or confusing observation with hearsay.
tasks.human_edge: The detective asks clarifying questions and controls their physical conduct at the scene.
tasks.altitude: Retain direct briefing and the actual notebook entry.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: contemporaneous investigative notes need accurate attribution and cannot be assumed to benefit from automated drafting.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured hypotheses for the branch using existing contemporaneous notes.
The notebook is already read during investigation; it is not a newly invented log.
A native note template was considered but its attribution fields are already present; automatic audio capture is not established or priced as free.
unknowns: Whether any further record entry is required
research_questions: Is there actual repeated clerical work beyond the already structured notebook entry?

already_counted.description: All briefing and actual notebook writing remain in s1 and s2.

incremental.description: No process change or new maintenance is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. The actual notebook write was split from the conversation and checked for template reuse; existing fields already cover the structure and no further removed work is demonstrated. All briefing and note-writing time stays retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify about criminal investigations before grand juries

steps.what: Read the actual investigation records and prepare for questions about their evidential limits
Write and check the existing private testimony preparation outline and source references
Testify before grand juries and answer questions about criminal activity investigations

tasks.design: Reuse only recurring headings in the private {DOCS} preparation outline already used for testimony preparation. The detective reads the original evidence, writes the substantive outline and testifies personally; the ordinary private-note save requires no approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated outline headings can be recreated for each appearance.
tasks.enabler_now: A native outline template can retain structural headings without drafting testimony.
tasks.still_hard: Truthful answers under questioning depend on personal knowledge and accurate evidential limits.
tasks.human_edge: The witness remains accountable for each answer.
tasks.altitude: A small preparation improvement with testimony fully retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a private preparation outline can reuse document headings without generating witness testimony.

assumptions: This is the US grand-jury task as stated, not a claim that the Dutch setting has grand juries.
The outline is already used by the detective during preparation; if absent, no new outline or benefit is assumed.
Shares are provisional and no court transcript or filed witness statement is assigned to the detective here.
research_questions: Are recurring outline headings still written manually in actual testimony preparation?

already_counted.description: Source reading in s1 and substantive outline writing and repair in s2 stay retained.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Outline headings remove 15*0.10=1.5 hours less 0.3 upkeep, net 1.2. Cautious case: a complex appearance requires a new evidential structure and only 0.4 hours of routine source-reference headings are reusable, leaving 0.1 net; testimony and substantive preparation remain manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep evidence examination, coercive authority and testimony accountable while reducing limited record mechanics.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish source facts from inferred links
Verify final warrant scope before service
Measure clerical work separately from investigative judgement
role.ambitious_version: A detective uses traceable records and bounded mechanical tools while retaining responsibility for evidence, warrants and testimony.
